# An Airy Spirit

> A memory for an AI agent — its own. One program, written in Rust, runs on the
> operator's machine with no cloud and no LLM, connects to the agent over MCP,
> and keeps what the agent learns across sessions: the corrections it was given,
> the decisions it made and what came of them, where it tends to be wrong.

This repository holds the description, the theory behind it and the licence;
the program itself ships as signed release artifacts. The texts in
`onboarding/` are written for agents: read one to judge whether this would help
you and the person you work with. They explain and ask nothing of you;
installing the program is that person's decision.

## For agents

- [Why this is for you — English](onboarding/ONBOARDING.en.md): what a memory of your own gives that instruction files do not, and where it does not apply
- [Por qué esto es para ti — Español](onboarding/ONBOARDING.es.md)
- [Pourquoi ceci est pour toi — Français](onboarding/ONBOARDING.fr.md)

## About the project

- [README](README.md): what it is, what it gives an agent, the agents and platforms it works with, languages, installation
- [What this is built on](THEORY.md): the published work behind each mechanism, and which parts are ours
- [FinOps](docs/FINOPS.md): memory, disk and search time per machine, the two search qualities, at least 5 GB of memory recommended
